name: MJD Advisors
team_size_estimate: ~7 employees (5-10 range; staff more than doubled in 2023)

startup_focus_evidence.signal: SOC-only boutique CPA firm serving 'software and cloud companies'; homepage testimonials are all SaaS/tech startups (Bonfire, Trovata, Pipedream, Weglot, Wednesday)
Fixed-fee pricing aimed at first-time SOC 2 startups: Type I $8K-$20K, Type II $15K-$35K, no hourly billing; targets 'tech startups and mid-stage SaaS companies seeking affordable first SOC 2 audits'
CEO Mike DeKock co-presented with Drata on 'what SOC 2 readiness actually looks like for startups' and appears on podcasts about simplifying tech compliance (Brains Byte Back)
Firm does only SOC 1/2/2+/3 engagements for technology companies — no tax, no financial audit; completed 300+ SOC 2 reports by 2023; named Accounting Today 2026 Best Firms for Technology

grc_partnerships: Vanta (listed Vanta Audit Partner per prior research notes; not independently re-verified on vanta.com)
aws_cloud_expertise: Third-party auditor profile credits MJD with fluency in 'cloud-native, AWS/GCP/Azure, containerized environments'; firm site emphasizes 'modern tech stack' and integrating the client's compliance platform and internal systems into the audit (source: https://soc2auditors.org/auditors/mjd-advisors/)
services: SOC 2 Type I and Type II examinations (fixed-fee)
partnership_angle: Referral partner + design-partner feeder — near-perfect profile: ~7-person founder-led SOC-only shop that lives entirely in the first-time-SOC-2 startup segment LoxeAI targets. They already operate inside GRC automation ecosystems (Drata Auditor Alliance, Vanta partner) and publicly celebrate tooling that streamlines evidence collection, so an AWS-native pre-audit scan slots naturally in front of their fixed-fee Type 2 engagements. Mike DeKock is content-forward (podcasts, Accounting Today columns, Drata webinars), making him both reachable and a high-leverage amplifier if he validates the scan.
pitch_note: Mike, you built MJD to make SOC 2 predictable for first-time startups — LoxeAI is trying to do the same one step earlier. It's an AWS-native readiness scan; we'd love 30 minutes for you to run it against a sandbox AWS account and pressure-test what it flags against what your auditors actually see in fieldwork. If it holds up, your pre-audit pipeline gets a simple play: 'run this scan first — it gets you ~80% ready,' which means cleaner fixed-fee engagements for MJD and fewer stalled readiness phases.
